Steady’s Pet Shop has been amazing with my pups! As a dog owner, it means a lot knowing they are in good hands. From helping me find what I need to providing top-quality grooming, they go above and beyond every time. They treat my pups with care, patience, and respect, and you can tell they truly love what they do. My pups came out looking great, smelling fresh, and feeling their best. Great people, great service, and a place I trust with my dogs. Highly recommend Steady’s Pet Shop!

The website associated with this page is a scam. Ordered something off of it over 3 weeks ago and can never get a straight answer when I contact customer service. First I was told it was out of stock and I would be refunded (I have not been refunded). A few days later they said they were shipping it the next day and I would have it a couple days after that. Last week I was told it had been shipped and would arrive soon (but they refused to give me an estimated arrival day). Meanwhile, my order tracking still says it is processing (not shipped, not delivered, it has not changed at all). They have charged me already and refuse to give me straight answers while the website says items ship in a couple days and arrive about a week after shipping. My order hasn't been processed in 3 weeks. Negative a million stars. Give me what I ordered or give me my money back... and shut down your fraudulent website while you're at it

EDIT: You could have reported the website listed on this page so it did not exist here. I used Google and Google maps to double check the website. Allowing it to remain on your Google maps page is bad for customers and bad for your business. Why you didnt get it removed is beyond me

Do not buy anything from this place. My dad ordered a kayak from their online site with it stating it would ship in 3 to 5 business days. The item never shipped and when we called to ask about the order we were hung up on and our number blocked. Complete scam and will be reporting
